title: Understudy
description: Your first job, rehearsed. A rehearsal studio for first jobs where the scroll pushes you through the logo's proscenium into the dark house, then runs the page like a show: an endless ring of parts, rehearsal, casting and a signed contract.
stack: Next.js 16 · React 19 · Scroll-Driven CSS · Original SVG · Lenis

sections.title: Top bar
sections.summary: (fixed): lockup left, live readout right. Ink flips to house over dark scenes.

sections.title: Hero
sections.summary: (`#top`, held for 340svh, sticky stage): the pale floor under a mist; eyebrow "The rehearsal studio for first jobs"; the headline "Your first job, / rehearsed." plus a cue dot; the arch under it (width `clamp(76px, 7.2vw, 112px)`, height ×1.1667, centred at `50% + clamp(84px, 12svh, 130px)`), its curtain breathing, rings of cue leaving its foot, and a "Scroll to enter" nudge. Inside the same stage, the **dark house** is a full-screen ink layer whose `clip-path` is the arch: curtains (night with fold stripes), a light slit, then "3,400+ / companies casting from our studio." over two rows of companies.

sections.title: Parts
sections.summary: (`#parts`, ink, one screen): "We cast you in the parts companies are hiring for." with chips (Popular, Product, Engineering, Data, Design, Growth, Operations; a pill glides between them as a `clip-path`, and ←/→ move it) and an **endless ring** of ten tall cards that drifts right to left (−36 px/s) in a gentle arc and loops with no seam: `loopX(i, n, slot, offset) = wrap(i·slot + offset + slot, n·slot) − slot`; short filtered sets repeat (`repsFor`) with the repeats hidden from readers; each card lifts and turns as it comes round the edges (`y = 34·d²`, `rotate = 5°·d`, `scale = 1 − 0.05·d²`, radius never under 560px). The page scroll pulls the ring along (0.32 px per px); drag it 1:1 and fling it (eased back with a frame-rate-independent `coast`); hover glides it to a stop; pause, keyboard focus or an open card brake it hard; previous / next (and ←/→ on the region) glide one card; a focused card glides fully into view; a drag never opens a card. One rAF loop writes the transforms and sleeps when still or off screen. Under reduced motion (and without JS) it's a plain row that scrolls natively. Each card shows: tag (Hot / Rising / New), "{weeks}-week run · {company}", title, tools, and a "Brief →" key. The card turns over (rotateY, inert faces) to the brief, three things you ship, and "Rehearse this part", which opens Start with that part chosen. Parts: AI Engineer (Quillo), Product Analyst (Parcelpost), Product Manager (fernway), Product Designer (Brightloop), Growth Marketer (sundry), Data Scientist (Tidewell), Frontend Engineer (LUMEN GAMES), Content Designer (Halcyon Bank), Operations Analyst (Saltbox), Customer Success Lead (Ledgerly).

sections.title: Rehearsal
sections.summary: (`#rehearsal`): a dark bowl (the parts' black ends in an ellipse) that flattens with the scroll; the held line "Learn the part by playing it." (sticky, behind a house fade); four scenes strung on one thread: a lead-in path from the line to a rail on the left, a node beside each scene. Scenes: "Join a company that runs like a *real one.*" (a lot of eight company buildings and a brief card: "31% of carts stall at the address step. Find out why."), "Run lines with your *cast.*" (a team chat whose messages arrive one by one and a standup checklist), "Get notes from your *director.*" (a readout with highlighted findings, three margin notes in Literata, "Approved"), "Walk out with a *reel.*" (Maya Ortiz, Product Analyst · Level 7, −18% drop-off, 4 fixes, 9 notes counting up). Each window has a three-light bar and a mono title.

sections.title: Casting
sections.summary: (`#casting`, held for 280svh): "You rehearse. We *cast.*", the reel in the middle of a 1200×600 stage, ten companies placed five each side; for each, a curve draws from the reel and then the company pops in; a "Callbacks" odometer rolls 00 → 10; a halo rings the reel when all ten are in.

sections.title: Contract
sections.summary: (`#pricing`, held for 250svh): "Built to get you [contract] *cast.*": a cue wave runs through the letters, a small two-sheet contract scales out of the gap, a signature draws on it, a cue seal stamps; then "Opening night is free. Then $89 a month.", the CTA "Book your first call time" (magnetic) and "Ask a question first", and three facts (10 h a week · 5–8 weeks to a reel · 62% got a callback).

sections.title: Finale
sections.summary: (the footer, held for 200svh): the floor pale, then the lit floor revealed by a `clip-path: circle()` growing from the ghost light; "House lights up. *Take the stage.*"; a glass ring whose text "START · TAKE THE STAGE ·" turns on a `textPath` around an ink core with the mark: the whole ring is the Start key. Legal links and "a fictional brand for a landing-page template".

sections.title: Dock
sections.summary: (fixed, bottom centre, glass that turns dark over dark scenes): Start (ink, cue on dark, sheen on hover, a halo pulse), menu (two bars morph to ×), "?" (Ask). A hairline across it fills with page progress. Any `[data-us-start]`, `[data-us-ask]` or `[data-us-go]` elsewhere opens the matching sheet or scrolls. Sheets open out of the dock with a `clip-path`, hold the page still (Lenis stops), trap focus, close on Escape or the scrim, and give focus back.
